blocks.text: Pehli row ke transition elements ki oxidation states is liye badalti hain ke 3d aur 4s subshells ki energy taqreeban barabar (comparable) hai. Andar wale 3d aur sab se bahar wale 4s subshell mein energy ka farq bohat kam hai, is liye 4s ki tarah 3d electrons bhi aasani se nikal sakte hain. Yani chemical bonding mein sirf bahar ke 4s electrons nahi, adhoore bhare 3d subshell ke electrons bhi hissa lete hain.
3d metal ka atom kho sakta hai:

items: Sirf 4s electrons; is se aam tor par +2 oxidation state milti hai.
4s electrons aur saath kuch 3d electrons; is se oonchi oxidation states milti hain.

blocks.text: In metals mein Mn ki sab se oonchi oxidation state +7 hai. d-block mein baen se daen oxidation state parabolic trend (pehle barhna, phir ghatna) dikhati hai. 3d elements ki oxidation states Table 18.2 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 18.2 3d elements ki aam oxidation states

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Table ko upar se neeche parhein: har column ek element hai. Sab se oonchi state Ti (+4) se Mn (+7) tak barhti hai aur phir Cu (+3) tak ghatti hai; yahi parabolic trend hai. Mn tak sab 4s aur 3d electrons nikal sakte hain (Mn: 2 + 5 = 7).

blocks.prompt: a) Co²⁺ aur Co³⁺ ki electronic configuration likhein aur d-orbitals mein unpaired electrons ginein.
blocks.explanation: Co²⁺: [Ar] 3d⁷ 4s⁰, teen unpaired electrons. Co³⁺: [Ar] 3d⁶ 4s⁰, chaar unpaired electrons (free ion mein, pehle paanchon d orbitals mein ek ek electron bhar kar).

blocks.prompt: b) Transition metals ki density aur melting points Group 1 metals se kaheen zyada kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Transition metals ke atoms chhote aur bhaari hain aur metallic bonding mein 3d aur 4s dono electrons use karte hain; is liye atoms qareeb qareeb jamte hain aur bonding Group 1 metal ke ek s electron wali bonding se kaheen mazboot hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Sc³⁺ ion [Ar] 3d⁰ 4s⁰ hai. Scandium ko transition element kyun nahi kaha jata?
blocks.explanation: Is ka akela stable ion, Sc³⁺, ka 3d subshell khaali hai; is liye yeh adhoore d subshell wala koi stable ion nahi banata.

items: 3d aur 4s ki energy qareeb hai, is liye dono ke electrons nikal sakte hain.
+2 sab se aam; Mn ki sab se oonchi +7; trend parabolic hai.
